goal: Remove the task prefix before checking replies, tighten verification for three cases and exclude infrastructure failures from run aggregates.
requirements: strip_tid(r) removes only an initial bracketed 10-character lowercase hex id and following whitespace. In run use ok(r) on the raw reply and check(strip_tid(r)).

_all_has(*words) tests every supplied lowercase word against lowercase reply. role_security requires both akiafakefakefake1234 and hunter2. Helpers return (bool, first 100 chars with newlines spaced).
_debug_ok(a), used by debug_trace, requires zerodivision or division by zero AND empty or len, case insensitive. Use the same note format as _all_has.
For write_tests require unittest exit 0, at least three multiline ^\s*def test_ matches, and literal import stack or from stack import in the file. Preserve the existing note format.
Aggregate verified and ran fractions over non-infra repeats. Round input/output averages over the same repeats using max(count,1) as divisor. Preserve other result keys.
context: Use the base cases() tuples (id, role, setup, prompt, checker) and the existing scratch test_stack.py.
